Stage 1 · Java foundations

JDK, JRE & JVM

Who builds, who runs, who executes — and the two commands you will type for months.

⏱ 15 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Script tools, studio, actor

JDK → JRE → JVM, each containing the last.

🎬

Script tools (JDK) → equipped studio (JRE) → actor (JVM) performing your scene. Writers need the studio; audiences need studio + actor.

Terminal commands
$ javac Main.java   # JDK builds: source -> class
$ java Main         # JRE/JVM runs it
Two tools, two jobs: javac consumes the FILE, java consumes the CLASS. Errors at step one = code problem; step two = runtime problem.
Step 2

Match tool to job

Build, launch, execute — place each.

Assign the jobs

javac, java, JVM — who does what?

“javac: command not found” = no JDK on PATH (JRE-only or nothing). An install problem, never a code problem.
